description: Figure: iron ligand conservation across R2 orthologs, occlusion of the Rnr4 metal pocket, and conservation of the radical tyrosine position
code:
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
pdb=open("prov/1JK0.pdb").read(); ch={}; zn=None
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
        rn=ln[17:20].strip(); c=ln[21]; rid=int(ln[22:26]); an=ln[12:16].strip()
        xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
        if rn in AA3: ch.setdefault(c,{}).setdefault(rid,{"aa":AA3[rn],"atoms":{}})["atoms"][an]=xyz
        elif rn=="ZN": zn=xyz
R=np.load("prov/R.npy"); t=np.load("prov/t.npy")
A,Bc=ch['A'],ch['B']; zn4=R@zn+t
BB={'C','N','O','CA'}
def mind(res, target):
    return min(np.linalg.norm(p-target) for an,p in res["atoms"].items() if an not in BB)
pairsFe=[(176,124),(179,127),(239,186),(273,220),(276,223)]
lab2=[f"Rnr2 {A[i]['aa']}{i}" for i,j in pairsFe]
lab4=[f"Rnr4 {Bc[j]['aa']}{j}" for i,j in pairsFe]
d2=[mind(A[i],zn) for i,j in pairsFe]; d4=[mind(Bc[j],zn4) for i,j in pairsFe]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,8.5))
# Panel A: conservation table
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,1,1); ax.axis("off")
cols=["D84/D145","E115/E176","H118/H179","E204/E239","E238/E273","H241/H276","Y122/Y183 (radical)"]
rows=["E. coli NrdB","S. cerevisiae Rnr2","S. cerevisiae Rnr4","H. sapiens RRM2","H. sapiens RRM2B"]
tbl=[["D85","E116","H119","E205","E239","H242","Y123"],
     ["D145","E176","H179","E239","E273","H276","Y183"],
     ["D93","E124","Y127","E186","R220","Y223","Y131"],
     ["D138","E169","H172","E232","E266","H269","Y176"],
     ["D100","E131","H134","E194","E228","H231","Y138"]]
ref=tbl[0]
cell=ax.table(cellText=tbl,rowLabels=rows,colLabels=cols,loc="center",cellLoc="center")
cell.auto_set_font_size(False); cell.set_fontsize(10); cell.scale(1,1.9)
for r in range(len(tbl)):
    for c in range(len(cols)):
        same = tbl[r][c][0]==ref[c][0]
        cell[(r+1,c)].set_facecolor("#dff0d8" if same else "#f2b8b5")
ax.set_title("Di-iron ligands and radical tyrosine mapped from E. coli NrdB by pairwise BLOSUM62 alignment\n"
             "(green: ligand type conserved, red: substituted). Rnr4 loses 3 of 6 iron ligands and keeps the radical Tyr position.",
             fontsize=11)
# Panel B
ax2=fig.add_subplot(2,2,3)
x=np.arange(len(pairsFe)); w=0.38
ax2.bar(x-w/2,d2,w,color="#2c7fb8",label="Rnr2 side chain to bound Zn (Fe2 site)")
ax2.bar(x+w/2,d4,w,color="#d95f0e",label="Rnr4 side chain to mapped metal position")
ax2.axhline(2.5,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax2.text(4.3,2.6,"coordination limit",fontsize=8,ha="right")
ax2.set_xticks(x); ax2.set_xticklabels([f"{a}\n{b}" for a,b in zip(lab2,lab4)],fontsize=8)
ax2.set_ylabel("minimum side chain atom distance (A)")
ax2.set_title("PDB 1JK0: metal site of Rnr2 vs structurally equivalent\nRnr4 pocket after superposition (242 CA, RMSD 1.12 A)",fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
# Panel C
ax3=fig.add_subplot(2,2,4)
y2=A[183]["atoms"]["OH"]; y4=Bc[131]["atoms"]["OH"]
vals=[float(np.linalg.norm((R@y2+t)-y4)), float(np.linalg.norm(y2-zn)), float(np.linalg.norm(y4-zn4))]
ax3.bar(["Rnr2 Tyr183 OH vs\nRnr4 Tyr131 OH\n(after superposition)","Rnr2 Tyr183 OH\nto bound Zn","Rnr4 Tyr131 OH\nto mapped metal site"],vals,
        color=["#31a354","#2c7fb8","#d95f0e"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax3.text(i,v+0.15,f"{v:.2f} A",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel("distance (A)"); ax3.set_ylim(0,11)
ax3.set_title("The radical tyrosine position is structurally\nconserved in Rnr4",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print("panel B values:", dict(zip(lab4,[round(v,2) for v in d4])))
print("Rnr2 ligand distances to Zn:", dict(zip(lab2,[round(v,2) for v in d2])))
print("panel C:", vals)
